text: . The Government has said that there is no shortage of sugar in the country and all necessary measures will be taken for adequate availability of sugar at reasonable prices. The Consumer Affairs Ministry said that ex-mill sugar prices have declined by around 20 per cent in recent days, while retail sugar prices have also started coming down.The Ministry said it has taken a series of proactive measures to ensure adequate availability of sugar and prevent artificial tightening of supplies in the domestic market. The Government has been closely monitoring sugar prices, stocks and movement across the country. It has decided to introduce a fortnightly sugar allocation system from next month, replacing the existing monthly quota system to ensure that sugar reaches the market in a timely manner.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that the Jan Dhan Yojana has delivered unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes, with an unparalleled impact in the last 12 years. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that Jan Dhan Yojana is playing a significant role in advancing financial inclusion and empowering people across the country. Under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, more than 59 crore accounts have been opened so far, with total deposits amounting to 3 lakh 17 thousand crore rupees. The scheme was launched by Prime Minister Modi on this day in 2014. As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, the scheme continues to redefine access to banking for all Indians. Under the scheme, 78 per cent of the accounts have been opened in rural or semi-urban areas, and approximately 56 per cent of accounts are owned by women.

. The Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC) has successfully dispatched the second ‘Onion Express’ of the season from Nashik, Maharashtra, to Chennai, Tamil Nadu. In a social media post, CWC said the initiative will further strengthen the supply chain and ensure the timely availability of onions across markets. It added that the initiative also reflects CWC’s commitment to efficient logistics, seamless movement of essential commodities, and supporting stable prices for consumers.

. Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) has increased the price of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) by Rs 3.89/kg. The new rate came into effect this morning. Following the revision, CNG in the national capital will now cost Rs 86.98/kg. In Gurugram, the revised price is Rs 92.1/kg, while consumers in Ghaziabad and Noida will have to pay Rs 95.59/kg.In a statement, IGL said that despite the price revision, CNG in Delhi continues to be among the most economical fuel options for consumers. The company attributed the increase to the re-escalation of the West Asia crisis. It said that the re-escalation of tensions disrupted LNG cargo movements through the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in global LNG prices nearly doubling compared with pre-crisis levels. Additionally, the approaching winter season has heightened urgency in Europe to replenish and increase natural gas storage levels.

. Hockey India has announced a cash award of 50 lakh rupees for the Indian Women’s Hockey Team for their historic fifth-place finish at the FIH Hockey Women’s World Cup 2026 in Belgium and the Netherlands. India defeated World No. 5 Germany 3-1 in Amstelveen on Thursday. It is India’s best World Cup finish since the team secured fourth place in the inaugural edition in 1974.Captain Salima Tete’s team lost only one match in the tournament. India held higher-ranked China, England and Australia to draws. The team also recorded a 6-1 win over South Africa. Hockey India President Padma Dilip Tirkey called the result historic. He said the fifth-place finish after 52 years reflects the team’s hard work, resilience and fighting spirit. Hockey India Secretary General Bhola Nath Singh also praised the team.He said Salima and her teammates had made the country proud by competing strongly against some of the world’s best teams. He said the award would motivate the players ahead of the Asian Games. FIH Hockey Women’s World Cup 2026 final between the Netherlands and Argentina will take place at Wagener Stadium in Amstelveen tonight.

. Hockey Bengal will organise its Annual Awards Ceremony 2026 in Kolkata today to mark National Sports Day and the 121st birth anniversary of legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand. The ceremony will honour players, coaches, umpires, journalists and organisations for their contribution to the development of hockey in Bengal. National Sports Day is observed on August 29 in memory of Major Dhyan Chand, a three-time Olympic gold medallist and one of India’s greatest hockey players.

. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has completed ten years of transforming digital payments and has emerged as the backbone of India’s digital payments ecosystem. The UPI, which was launched on 25th August 2016, has surged almost 13 thousand fold in transaction volume. The Finance Ministry said that the annual transaction volume expanded from just 1.78 crore transactions in 2016-17 to over 24 thousand 162 crore transactions in 2025-26. The transaction value also rose sharply from seven thousand crore to nearly 314 lakh crore during the same time period. The Ministry said that UPI has also emerged as a global platform for cross-border digital payments and is currently operational in 11 countries. These are United Arab Emirates, France, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Singapore, Mauritius, Qatar, Cambodia, Greece and Maldives.UPI has emerged as one of the most successful pillars of India’s Digital Public Infrastructure, providing an interoperable, real-time payments platform. Today, it is the preferred mode of payment for millions of users, transforming the way India transacts. By bridging the digital divide, advancing financial inclusion, and expanding access to digital financial services, UPI has empowered individuals and communities across the country while driving broad-based economic participation. The unprecedented scale and reliability achieved by UPI have received global recognition. It said, the International Monetary Fund has acknowledged it as the world’s largest real‑time payment system. As of 2025, UPI accounts for nearly 49 per cent of the world’s real-time payment transaction volume.

. Ahead of Independence Day, a platform for creative expression has been provided to the youth in Uttar Pradesh. For this, the ‘Rang De Basanti’ campaign was launched. Under this campaign, the graffiti wall programme organised near Lucknow University today. Artists from the city painted public murals on the theme of a mafia-free and changing Uttar Pradesh. Through these paintings, the Uttar Pradesh of before 2017 and the changes that have taken place in Uttar Pradesh thereafter were portrayed.On the wall, artists used their colours and imagination to portray in paintings the changed positive environment in the state in terms of law and order, infrastructure and opportunities for youth. Young painter Manish Saroj’s painting expressed the pain of Uttar Pradesh suffering under mafia rule before 2017, while also presenting a positive picture of the change taking place now.Under the campaign, a comic distribution and dialogue programme will be organised in Muzaffarnagar tomorrow. During this, an original comic based on communal harmony will be distributed. Along with this, dialogues will also be held with youth in schools. On August 14, the song ‘Azadi from Fear’ of the ‘Rang De Basanti’ campaign will be launched. It will also feature a confluence of rap, music and digital art.

. The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas has clarified that the revised pricing framework for Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme has been designed to provide a stable and viable price to CBG producers while ensuring that consumers do not face any material increase in CNG and household PNG prices.According to a recent newspaper article, the revised price of Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme could place a significant additional burden on CNG and household PNG consumers. However, the Ministry explained that this conclusion does not present the correct picture, as it does not account for the Government’s affordability support and the substantially wider domestic gas pool over which the net cost of CBG will now be distributed.The Ministry explained that under the existing system, the procurement price paid to CBG producers is approximately 1 thousand 478 rupees per Million British thermal units, while the revised procurement price under the GOBARdhan Scheme is 2,110 rupees per Million British thermal units. It noted that the Government will also provide affordability support of 10 rupees per kilogram of CBG, equivalent to around 215 rupees per Million British thermal units with 95 per cent methane content, reducing the effective cost to approximately 1,895 rupees per Million British thermal units.Additionally, CBG will be pooled with other domestically produced natural gas, with its net cost spread across a significantly larger domestic gas pool, approximately 2.5 to 3 times the earlier base. The Ministry highlighted that this wider pooling mechanism will substantially minimise the impact on individual CNG and household PNG consumers.The Ministry further emphasized that the revised pricing framework has been carefully designed to balance two key objectives. These include ensuring a stable and viable price for CBG producers to enable sustainable plant operations, while Government-funded affordability support and a substantially wider gas pool protect consumers from any material impact on prices.

. India’s Industrial output growth, as measured by the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), expanded by 6.7 per cent in July this year on an annual basis. The July data indicates that industrial activity continued to expand at a healthy pace, although the pace of growth moderated from the revised June level.The sharp upward revision in June’s IIP growth to 8.8 per cent from 7.3 per cent also indicates that the industrial momentum entering the July quarter was stronger than initially estimated. According to government data, Manufacturing, which carries the heaviest weight in the index, grew by 7.3 per cent, while electricity and gas supply posted an 8.7 per cent expansion in July. Water supply, sewerage and waste management rose by 7.4 per cent. However, the mining sector proved to be a laggard, posting a negative growth of 0.9 per cent last month.

. Vice President C P Radhakrishnan has extended his greetings on the occasion of National Sports Day today. In a social media post, Mr Radhakrishnan paid tribute to Indian Hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand and said that the spirit of determination, discipline and excellence defines Bharat’s sporting culture. He noted that the nation’s growing sports ecosystem reflects the commitment to nurturing talent at every level.Mr Radhakrishnan said that Indian athletes continue to shine on the global stage, bringing laurels to the nation and inspiring the next generation to aim higher. The Vice President also called for renewed efforts to promote fitness, encourage greater participation in sports and inspire young Indians to pursue excellence with dedication and perseverance.

. Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Bhatti Vikramarka has directed Singareni officials to explore a joint venture with Karnataka’s Hatti Gold Mines for future gold mining projects. He gave these instructions during a visit to the Hatti and UTI gold mines in Raichur district, Karnataka, on the second day of his tour to the region.The Deputy CM, who also holds the Finance and Energy portfolios, said combining the technical expertise of both public sector companies could improve India’s domestic gold production. He noted that Hatti Gold Mines has vast experience in gold exploration, mining, processing and refining, and suggested that Singareni’s technical skills in coal and mineral mining be combined with this experience. Bhatti Vikramarka said gold plays a key role in the country’s economic security, and government companies like Singareni should take the lead in scientifically exploring domestic gold reserves to reduce import dependence.During the visit, he inspected the production unit, mineral processing centre and electro-winning unit at Hatti Gold Mines. Officials told him the project currently produces two to four kilograms of gold daily. He also visited the UTI open-cast and underground gold mines, and asked officials about mining technology, transport and worker safety. Singareni CMD Dr Buddha Prakash Jyothi and other senior officials accompanied him on the tour.

. The BJP has accused the Congress of using the Dalit community as a political tool. Addressing a news conference in New Delhi, BJP national spokesperson Dr. Guru Prakash Paswan alleged that the Congress has a history of insulting the community. He said the Narendra Modi government, in contrast, has honoured the legacy of B.R. Ambedkar by according pilgrimage status to places associated with him.BJP national spokesperson Dr. Sudhanshu Trivedi accused the Congress of seeking to divide Hindus for political gain. He cited Article 370, alleging that its provisions led to discriminatory domicile restrictions against members of the Valmiki community in Jammu and Kashmir.The BJP leaders made the remarks while highlighting what they described as the Congress’ record on Dalit issues and contrasting it with the Modi government’s initiatives linked to Ambedkar’s legacy. Earlier in the day, senior Congress leader Rahul Gandhi had raised the issue of discrimination against dalit community.

. Union Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said that as global companies reassess their supply chains and capital allocation, India offers not only the scale of a vast market but also the depth of a long-term investment and operating platform. She made these remarks while addressing a high-level Business Roundtable with leading investors and business leaders in Chicago, United States. She highlighted India’s broad-based growth, reform momentum and expanding opportunities for long-term investment.Ms Sitharaman also emphasised that India’s investment appeal lies in the convergence of scale, sustained economic growth, skilled talent, world-class infrastructure, technological advancement and a decade of consistent reforms.A key focus of the meeting was “Manufacture in India – for India and for the world”, with opportunities across manufacturing, AI and digital, financial services, infrastructure, food processing, defence and advanced technologies. Ms Sitharaman noted that India’s Digital Public Infrastructure, including Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC and India Stack, has created platforms operating at population scale. She added that the country’s next phase of growth lies in building high-value businesses in AI, engineering, analytics, product development, semiconductors and electronics, with Global Capability Centres increasingly evolving into global innovation hubs.Ms Sitharaman underlined that GIFT IFSC is emerging as an international financial centre connecting global capital with Indian opportunities. Referring to the reconfiguration of global supply chains, the Minister said India combines a large domestic market with globally competitive manufacturing capabilities, with the focus now shifting beyond assembly to deeper component manufacturing, engineering and advanced technologies, supported by Production Linked Incentive schemes.Highlighting initiatives such as Atmanirbhar Bharat and iDEX, Ms Sitharaman said India is strengthening domestic capabilities in drones, autonomous systems and other advanced technologies. She also invited global partners to co-develop, co-produce and build for global markets, urging them to view India not merely as a market to serve but as a platform from which to build for the world.The Roundtable was organised by the Consulate General of India in Chicago in association with the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum.

. India’s Velavan Senthilkumar won the PSA Budapest Squash Open title in Hungary after defeating home favourite Balazs Farkas 3-0 in the final. He had an impressive run to the title, beating World No. 18 and Asian Games gold medallist Eain Yow Ng 3-0 in the quarterfinals before overcoming fellow Indian Veer Chotrani 3-2 in a thrilling semifinal. Senthilkumar capped his remarkable week with a dominant performance in the final.

. Vice President CP Radhakrishnan has said that the country today stands as an important place of transformation and renewed confidence, showcasing the results of collective determination and efforts. The Vice President said this after releasing a book titled Sankalp Se Siddhi ka Modi Yug written by Rajya Sabha MP Ghanshyam Tiwari. He said that whether it is advancing technology, building modern infrastructure, and strengthening national unity and promoting women-led development, education is the tool for empowerment. Mr Radhakrishnan also highlighted the contributions of the country’s youth, women, farmers, workers, and every citizen for their involvement in building a stronger and prosperous nation. He also underlined that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is the only leader in the world to provide free Covid-19 vaccines not only to 140 crore Indian people but also to hundred more countries.Speaking about the book, the Vice President said that through the publication, the author seeks to bring together many aspects of country’s larger narratives, reviving pride in cultural heritage and enhancing the country’s voice at the global stage. He added that the book reflects the journey of the nation and encourages everyone and boosts their enthusiasm.

. Mizo footballer Lallianzuala Chhangte has been named Indian Footballer of the Year 2026. The 29-year-old, who recently moved from Mumbai FC to Mohun Bagan, received the award from Indian football legend Bhaichung Bhutia last night. Organised by the Football Players Association of India, the award is decided through votes from fellow players. Chhangte had previously won the honour for the 2023-24 season. Chief Minister Lalduhoma congratulated Chhangte, while the Mizoram Football Association hailed the achievement as a proud moment and said it would inspire the next generation of Mizo footballers.

. All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi has introduced a new course titled GARBHINI MITRA to Strengthen Ayurveda-Based Maternal Wellness Support for the 2026-2027 academic session.The Ministry of AYUSH said that the six-month course is designed to develop trained personnel to provide appropriate health education, lifestyle guidance, and community-level support to women during pregnancy and the postnatal period.The ministry noted that Candidates of 18 years or above, who have passed the Senior Secondary examination from any recognized board are eligible to apply before its last date that is 31st August.Once completed, candidates can work as Garbhini Mitra Assistants, Prenatal or Postnatal Care Assistants, Antenatal Wellness Guides and Maternal Health Support Workers, across different Ayush centres, maternity clinics and wellness institutions.The course inculcates traditional ayurvedic concepts of Garbhini Paricharya, Sutika Paricharya and Garbhadhana Vidhi.

. India’s double Olympic medallist Neeraj Chopra has qualified for the 2026 Diamond League final, which will be held in Brussels next month. Chopra accumulated 12 points in the standings. Chopra had finished fourth at the Doha meet in June with a throw of 85.69 metres before recording a season-best 88.05 metres at the Lausanne meet earlier this month, where he finished second. Chopra is sixth in the standings after competing in two Diamond League meets this season. Chopra’s two performances were enough to secure a place in the Diamond League final.

. Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports Dr Mansukh Mandaviya today participated in the 88th edition of Fit India Sundays on Cycle in New Delhi. The event was a special National Sports Day edition of the initiative, organised in collaboration with BRICS at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium. Talking to the media, Dr Mandaviya said that cycling has become popular among citizens.Highlighting the importance of Cycling, the Minister said that it is an excellent form of exercise, key to a pollution-free environment, and an effective solution to traffic congestion. The Minister also urged the youth to dedicate at least one hour daily to sports and physical activities to stay fit and healthy.Meanwhile, Head Coach of the Indian Cricket Team, Gautam Gambhir, said that the Fit India initiative will drive the country towards a fitter, stronger and self-reliant nation. He also called on the youth to participate in the movement.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will address the Industry Conclave in Lucknow today, on the third and last day of his three-day visit to the city. The conclave is being organised under the PM Setu Yojana, where discussions will be held on topics related to skill development, entrepreneurship, and vocational education. Before attending the conclave, Mr Singh will listen to Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Mann Ki Baat programme. He will also lay the foundation stones for 12 development projects worth rupees 101 crore in the Lucknow Cantonment area in the presence of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath.On the second day of his visit yesterday, the Defence Minister inaugurated the Fragrance Park in Lucknow and said that parks and public spaces bring people together. In an increasingly busy lifestyle, such spaces help strengthen social bonds. During the programme, he unveiled statues of Lala Lajpat Rai and Shaheed Bhagat and also laid the foundation stone of various development projects worth rupees 4,313 lakh. He also addressed the 11th Convocation ceremony of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University and inaugurated a senior citizens’ home in the Gomti Nagar area.

. The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has achieved a major milestone in its nationwide mission-mode drive for Mandatory Biometric Updates, completing more than two crore biometric updates for school children across the country. The special drive, initiated in September last year, has now covered over one lakh 56 thousand schools, enabling school children to complete their Aadhaar biometric. Electronics and IT Ministry said that this has helped Mandatory Biometric Updates service to reach children directly at their schools, making the process more accessible and convenient for crores of students.Aadhaar enrolment for children below five years captures demographic information and a photograph, while fingerprints and iris biometrics are not captured at that age as these biometrics are still developing. Mandatory Biometric Updates helps ensure that the child’s Aadhaar continues to have updated biometric information. The Biometric updates are required when a child attains the age of 5 years and again at 15 years. To encourage timely completion and make the service more accessible, UIDAI had waived the charges for  children in the 7 to 15 years age group from 1st October 2025, for a period of one year. The Ministry said that lack of Biometric Updates in Aadhaar may lead to difficulties while carrying out authentication for receiving benefits under various Government schemes, registering in competitive and university examinations.

. In women’s cricket, India will begin their T20 Asia Cup campaign against Thailand today at Dubai International Cricket Stadium. The match will start at 8:30 PM Indian Time. Harmanpreet Kaur will lead India, while Smriti Mandhana will be the vice-captain.India are the most successful team in the competition’s history, winning three of five editions. However, they enter the tournament after the group-stage exits at the T20 World Cup. Thailand opened the tournament with a win over Hong Kong China on Friday. The eight-team Women’s T20 Asia Cup sees India in Group A with Thailand, Hong Kong, and Pakistan.

. An 11-member technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in Nepal’s flood-affected areas yesterday to facilitate search and rescue of stranded individuals. The team – comprising doctors, paramedics and tunnel engineers – had arrived in Kathmandu on Friday.Yesterday, they reached Trishuli in Nuwakot district to assist in efforts to rescue workers trapped in a tunnel belonging to a hydropower project. After completing an aerial survey of the Chilime and Langtang areas, the Indian team began necessary rescue-related work around the tunnel area, according to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority.An 82-member joint security team comprising Nepal Army, Armed Police Force and Nepal Police personnel has been working since last night to clear debris and reach people believed to be trapped inside the tunnel.Nepali security forces have so far rescued 191 workers from tunnels at various hydropower projects in the country, according to the Nepal Army. However, reports of more people trapped inside tunnels prompted Nepalese authorities to seek India’s assistance.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is on a two-day visit to Uzbekistan. The country which has age-old ties with India. Both were earlier connected through the Silk Route and the people here love Indian culture, particularly Bollywood films, songs, yoga, Hindi and Indian food.Akashvani correspondent reports that there is close affinity between the cultures of the two countries. Indian films, actors and songs are extremely popular in Uzbekistan since the era of Raj Kapoor. A 5-day Indian Cinema Week from 17 to 21 December 2024 was organised to commemorate the 100th birth anniversary of Raj Kapoor, and a 4-day Film Festival was organised on the theme ‘Sashakt Nari – Celebrating Womanhood’ in 2025 and 2026, showcasing women-centric films from Hindi and regional cinema. Akashvani spoke to a young Uzbek National who narrated how he has grown up watching Indian movies and loves Shah Rukh Khan.He said that Yoga is immensely popular, with more than 2000 participants attending International Yoga Day every year. Yoga Federation of Uzbekistan maintains a close relationship with the Indian Embassy. Two batches of Yoga Volunteers from the Yoga Federation of Uzbekistan (YFU) have been certified by the Ministry of Ayush to teach Yoga. The 7th International Conference on Yoga under the theme ‘Yoga for One Earth One Health’ was held in Tashkent last year.Speaking to Aakshvani News, a yoga practitioner, Krysina said that yoga has benefited her a lot. She was also part of the first International Yoga Day celebrations in Delhi.She said that Yoga, films, food, spices and literature are keeping alive the age-old relationship between the two country who were earlier connected through the Silk Road.

. Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan will arrive in Keralam today for a two-day official visit. He will attend the jubilee celebrations of the Kerala Kaumudi daily in Alappuzha. Following this, Vice President will inaugurate the Aranmula Boat Race in Pathanamthitta district. In the evening, the Vice President will flag off the grand concluding parade of the Onam Tourism Week celebrations in Thiruvananthapuram.

. On the eve of Raksha Bandhan, President Droupadi Murmu has extended greetings to people. The President said that the festival of Raksha Bandhan has been an integral part of country’s culture and tradition since ancient times. She said that rakhi thread, tied around the wrist with faith, is regarded as a sacred bond of protection, known as Raksha Bandhan.The President  said that in many shlokas and mantras, Rakshe, Ma Chala, Ma Chala can be found which expresses the imploration that may this bond of protection continue forever. President Murmu urged every citizen to take a pledge to strengthen the bonds amongst families and communities, marching forward with this spirit towards a Viksit Bharat.Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla also extended greetings to countrymen on the eve of Raksha Bandhan. In his message, Mr Birla said festival that celebrates the mutual love, affection, and trust between brothers and sisters. He noted that the festival symbolizes of India’s rich culture, family values, and the unbreakable bonds of affection and belonging.

. The Publications Division of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has received seven awards at the Federation of Indian Publishers (FIP) Awards for Excellence in Book Production, 2026. The Division’s journals, books and reference publications in Hindi, English and Urdu have been recognised in various categories.Director General, Publications Division, Dr. Dhiraj Kakadia said that the books and journals published by the Division play an important role in bringing diverse and valuable content related to national development, literature, culture, art and contemporary issues to readers. He said, the seven awards received by the Publications Division are a testament to the collective hard work, dedication and excellence of its officers and personnel.

. Minister of State for External Affairs Pabitra Margherita interacted with the Indian diaspora in Laos and appreciated their contribution to strengthening ties between the two nations. The Minister also interacted with alumni of the Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation Programme (ITEC) and the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) in Vientiane.Earlier in the day, Mr Margherita held an interaction with stakeholders from the tourism and textile sectors of Laos.

. At least 37 people have been killed following a Russian attack on the Bucha district, close to the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, officials said today.According to the head of the local regional military administration, at least 50 residential buildings were damaged in the attack, which also sparked a large-scale fire that spread to homes and a restaurant.In a statement, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a warehouse in the village of Myla had been struck, followed by a detonation. The statement also said that a care home for elderly people and people with disabilities, as well as residential buildings, were damaged.

. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla paid tributes to former Lok Sabha Speaker Sardar Hukam Singh on his birth anniversary today. In a social media post, Mr Birla said that Sardar Hukam Singh was a skilled politician, a sharp legal expert, and an outstanding orator. He added that Sardar Hukam Singh as a presiding officer established several healthy traditions in the conduct of the House and attached special importance to maintaining discipline and decorum in the House for the effective functioning of parliamentary democracy.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi reached Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan, this evening for his two-day visit to the Central Asian country. The Prime Minister was welcomed by President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev at the airport. Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid a wreath at Yangi Uzbekistan Park in the presence of President Shavkat Mirziyoyev. Both leaders will hold discussions on the entire gamut of issues of bilateral importance.Tashkent has been decked up to welcome Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who is visiting the country from today. The entire city is adorned with Indian flags and hoardings as the country eagerly awaited the fourth visit by PM Modi. The Indian diaspora in Tashkent also gathered for a special welcome for Prime Minister Modi.Tomorrow, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev will reflect on the entire spectrum of bilateral relations, based on civilisational ties built over centuries and strengthened by strong people-to-people ties. The two leaders will review cooperation in trade and investment, defence, digital connectivity, energy, education and people-to-people ties at the Presidential Palace. They will also share perspectives on advancing the shared developmental visions of Viksit Bharat 2047 and Uzbekistan-2030.The Prime Minister is also expected to visit the Shastri Memorial in Tashkent and the Mahatma Gandhi Centre at the Tashkent State University of Oriental Studies.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will share his thoughts with the people of the country and abroad in the Mann Ki Baat programme on Akashvani at 11 AM on Sunday. It will be the 137th episode of the monthly radio programme. The programme will be broadcast across the entire Akashvani and Doordarshan network, the AIR News website, and the Newsonair mobile app. It will also be live-streamed on the YouTube channels of AIR News, DD News, the PMO, and the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Akashvani will broadcast the programme in regional languages immediately after the Hindi broadcast.

. Global crude oil prices eased today. Brent crude was trading half a per cent down at 89 US dollars and 30 cents per barrel in intra-day trade. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 0.8 per cent lower at 82 US dollars and 84 cents per barrel when reports last came in.

. The 4th flight carrying 11 tonnes of relief assistance has landed in Kathmandu, and relief material has been handed over to the Nepal government. In a social media post, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar said that the flight carried essential supplies and technical capabilities to support Nepal’s ongoing rescue and relief operations. Earlier, India had sent more than 57 tonnes of emergency relief supplies in three flights.

. Maharashtra Minister for Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Development and Cultural Affairs Ashish Shelar has been elected President of the Esports Games Federation (ESGF). Shelar was elected at the federation’s general body meeting, attended by representatives from 22 states.After taking charge, Shelar said efforts would be made to give esports a more structured, transparent and professional framework to attract investment and generate employment. He said esports should be developed beyond entertainment and gaming into a field offering skills, training, discipline and career opportunities for young people.According to the federation, India has around 52 crore gamers, with about 11 crore people playing games every day. Tournaments are organised in 28 games, while esports viewership is estimated at 8 to 9 crore.The ESGF aims to establish a structured system for esports, including national teams, selection processes, competitions, training, rules and international representation, similar to traditional sports. The federation expressed confidence that Shelar’s experience with various sports organisations would provide fresh impetus to the development of esports in the country.

. Nepal’s flash flood death toll has risen to 675 as search and rescue operations continue amid renewed rainfall and fears of further flooding. Nearly 2,400 people remain missing, including at least 320 foreign nationals. More than 4,400 people have been rescued or evacuated, including 261 foreign tourists who had lost contact.Akashvani correspondent reports that the Nepal Police reported that 675 bodies have been recovered from eight districts, with the highest numbers reported in Chitawan, Nawalparasi East, and Nawalparasi West. Over 15,000 security personnel have been deployed, while helicopters are carrying out repeated sorties to rescue stranded people and deliver relief supplies. According to officials in the hard-hit Rasuwa district, search and rescue operations resumed yesterday after being temporarily halted because of rain and fog.The Nepal government has issued a fresh alert for flooding in the Bhote Koshi River and urged residents living along the river to remain cautious. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority has reported an increased flood flow in the river. The Rasuwa District Administration said it has heard an increase in water flow and advised people in areas near the Bhote Koshi River in the Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading districts to exercise caution. It said further updates will be provided as more information becomes available.The Bhote Koshi is a fast-flowing Himalayan river originating in Tibet. Seven people have also died on the Chinese side of the border, with more than 550 reported missing. The Mugling-Kathmandu highway, a major road link connecting the capital with other parts of the country, reopened yesterday after remaining closed since Wednesday. But several other roads remain blocked or difficult to access.

. On National Sports Day today, Nagaland Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio said the state celebrates the dedication and perseverance of its sportspersons and recognises the role of sports in promoting fitness, discipline and teamwork. In a post in X, Mr Rio called upon all stakeholders to continue strengthening the state’s sporting ecosystem and inspire a culture of active living, inclusivity and excellence. Meanwhile, in commemoration of National Sports Day 2026, the Directorate of Youth Resources and Sports, Nagaland, will honour meritorious sportspersons for 2025-26 this morning at a programme to be held in Kohima.

. The Tata Institute of Social Sciences, TISS, conferred degrees on 1,376 students and scholars at its 86th annual convocation held in Mumbai yesterday.The degrees included those awarded to 35 doctoral scholars and graduates from Master’s, Bachelor’s, Integrated and dual-degree programmes.The first undergraduate batch of Analytics and Sustainability Studies also received their degrees. Director of Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr C. S. Pramesh, was the chief guest at the convocation.

UAE’s Central Bank has decided to conduct a special and urgent examination of Banque Misr branches in the Emirates, after the US Treasury flagged that they processed transactions potentially part of Iranian shadow banking networks.Under Operation Economic Outcast, the U.S. Department of the Treasury had proposed to revoke Banque Misr UAE’s correspondent banking access to U.S. financial institutions. This would effectively block U.S. dollar transactions for UAE Branches of Egypt’s second-largest bank. The departmentsaidthat between January 2024 and June 2026, Banque Misr UAE processed approximately $1.8 billion for 103 companies potentially part of Iranian shadow banking networks. The US has alleged that Iran uses these networks to launder funds, procure weapons, and bankroll its regional proxies.The UAE has now decided to conduct a forensic lookback covering the period mentioned above, focusing on transactions of the companies the U.S. identified. The Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) stressed that Banque Misr’s UAE branches remain subject totheEmirates’ laws and regulations. It also urged that banks licensed in the UAE are expected not to expose the country’s financial system to reputational risks and must not misuse the UAE’s advanced financial infrastructure.It also underlined that the appropriate decision in this regard will be taken in due course, taking into consideration the obligations of the bank towards its customers in the UAE. Earlier on 18th August, UAE had suspended all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran, following detection of two ballistic missiles launched from Iran toward maritime traffic in the Gulf.In a statement released on the issue, Banque Misr clarified that the US Treasury action constitutes a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM), which is subject to a formal period for receiving and reviewing comments before any final rule is issued. The proposal is subject to a 30-day comment period and would affect the Egyptian Bank if finalised at the end of it. The Bank further clarified that the regulatory action is limited to Banque Misr’s branch in the United Arab Emirates and does not extend to Banque Misr’s operations in the Arab Republic of Egypt or any other country where it has a presence.

. Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh today informed that around 440 space technology startups are registered in India. In a written reply in Lok Sabha, Dr Singh said Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre, IN-SPACe has granted 113 authorisations to 52 Non-Government Entities, NGEs to carry out various space activities. Out of these, 18 NGEs are start-ups. The Minister said the Government has undertaken several proactive measures following the liberalization of the space sector. This is being done to promote participation of startups in satellite manufacturing, launch services, downstream applications and space-based technologies. IN-SPACe is facilitating the transfer of available ISRO technologies to industry while also identifying and consolidating the technology requirements of industry for future technology development and transfer. Till date, 118 Technology Transfer Agreements have been executed.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that the ‘Nasha-mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat’ campaign is gaining momentum rapidly across the country. Sharing his thoughts in the Mann Ki Baat programme on Akashvani this morning, Mr Modi expressed happiness that the campaign with the goal for drug-free youth and a drug-free India is not merely a formality, as many people, especially the youth are joining it in large numbers. He said,  this is the collective resolve for the health, happiness, and bright future of India’s youth.The Prime Minister said, drug addiction does not just engulf a single individual but the entire family and society bear the consequences. He commended those who raise awareness against drugs and step forward to help individuals struggling with addiction. Mr Modi asked people to come up with a powerful slogan for a drug-free India and young musicians to create songs that convey the message of a drug-free life. He said, the country has no shortage of excellent content creators. Mr Modi urged them to create content in various languages to help society in this endeavor. He said, they can use their creativity as a medium for social change.The Prime Minister said, lakhs of women are gaining new strength through the ‘PM SVANidhi Yojana’. He said, this aspect of ‘women empowerment’ is not discussed as much as it should be. Mr Modi said, Women account for approximately 46 percent of the beneficiaries of the ‘PM SVANidhi Yojana’. He said, around 35 lakh women across the country are expanding their businesses by connecting with this scheme.Mr Modi spoke about Babita Sharma of Ghaziabad and T.S. Ningamma from Bengaluru who have benefited from the scheme. He said, when a woman’s business grows, the future of her entire family advances along with it, children receive a better education, household needs are met, and the woman’s self-confidence is strengthened. He said, this is, indeed, a living example of women’s empowerment.The Prime Minister said cleanliness has a remarkable quality. He said, when the resolve to keep a place clean becomes the people’s own commitment, it completely changes the identity of that place. Mr Modi said, such efforts towards cleanliness in various parts of the country constantly inspire people. He mentioned Akash and Rohan of Patwai in Uttar Pradesh, who inspired others to clean up public places, including river ghats. The Prime Minister also spoke about Shri Amarnath Yatra where more than 400 metric tonnes of waste was collected and processed. He said, Maithili Bhue of Dhodrokusum in the Debrigarh region of Odisha has shown that it is possible to protect nature while also achieving prosperity in life.Mr Modi said, today the flight of the country’s daughters’ dreams is soaring from the earth to outer space. He said, India is bringing together thousands of daughters who are nurturing such dreams from across the globe.’ The Prime Minister said, the initiative is named ‘Mission ShaktiSAT,  and through it, 12 thousand girl students from 108 countries are getting the opportunity to learn satellite technology in the field of innovation.He said, on National Space Day this month, a wonderful glimpse of this mission was seen in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh where the second phase of Mission ShaktiSAT was launched at the Gautam Buddha University. Mr Modi mentioned how Varadaraj from Kadappa in Andhra Pradesh, Chandrashekharan from Kodaikanal in Tamil Nadu are cultivating avocados and earning additional income.Mr Modi spoke to Krishna Sheshadri from Mumbai who has created a unique website www.bharatrajya.com. By selecting any year in the website people can easily find out which ruler ruled over which part of India at that time. He said, this initiative by Mr Krishna will help not only history students but people to learn about the past in an engaging way.The Prime Minister said, the month of August brought with it myriad hues of patriotism all around. He said, occasions such as ‘National Handloom Day’ and the anniversary of the ‘Quit India Movement’ to ‘Partition Horrors Remembrance Day’ make this month special. Mr Modi said, Independence Day and National Space Day fill every countryman with pride.He said, the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign further strengthens this sentiment. He added that this year has become even more special as it marks the 150th anniversary of ‘Vande Mataram’. Mr Modi said, this time, over eight crore ‘Tiranga selfies’ were uploaded. He said, this year, through the ‘Suryapath Tiranga’ initiative, the National flag embarked on a unique journey across the globe. The Prime Minister said, the Tricolour was hoisted in Suva, Fiji, at the first light of dawn. Subsequently, it was unfurled at Indian Missions and Posts across Asia, Africa, Europe, and eventually San Francisco in America.Mr Modi said, on 3rd of next month, the nation will celebrate the birth centenary of the legendary Uttam Kumar. He said, Uttam Kumar was a versatile actor who became deeply embedded in people’s hearts through his acting. The Prime Minister said, the festivals and celebrations not only uphold the traditions but also provide opportunities to connect with one another.He said, in the coming days, India is set to celebrate several more significant festivals like Janmashtami and Vishwakarma Puja. Deepawali is also approaching in a few months, and preparations for it are already gradually underway. He urged people to become ‘Vocal for Local during this festive season.The Prime Minister said, being ‘Vocal for Local’ does not merely mean buying earthen lamps as the vision behind it is much broader. He said, the path to India becoming self-reliant will be paved only by taking pride in products made in India.

. The death toll from devastating flash floods in Nepal and Tibet has risen to 669, with more than 2,000 people still missing. Search and rescue operations are underway across the affected districts of the Himalayan nation. Officials said the police are coordinating with residents and other agencies to locate missing people and assist those stranded by the floods.India has stepped up humanitarian assistance to Nepal following the flash floods. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said that India is concerned about the crisis situation in Nepal. Talking to reporters in Lucknow, Mr Singh said that India has been continuously sending assistance to the neighbouring country.The External Affairs Ministry has said that 88 Indian nationals have been rescued so far in Nepal following the flash flood tragedy on Wednesday. In a social media post, External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that 287 Indian nationals are reportedly missing. He said that around 128 people of Indian origin, holding other nationalities, also remain missing.Mr Jaiswal informed that four Indian nationals were rescued today from a hydropower project in Rasuwa. He added that 120 Indian nationals crossed into Nepal from China today.

. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red-colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall with isolated extremely heavy rainfall over Odisha today. According to IMD, places over Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Chhattisgarh and Gangetic West Bengal are expected to witness heavy to very heavy rainfall today.The Met Department has also predicted heavy rainfall over Bihar, Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh, East Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Sub Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim, and Vidarbha for the day. Further, the weather agency has forecast thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds over Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal today.

. President Droupadi Murmu will grace the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) Combined Convocation 2026 in New Delhi tomorrow. Graduating students from 18 NIFT campuses across the country will come together to celebrate the conferment of their degrees and mark the culmination of their academic journey.Union Minister of Textiles Giriraj Singh will also be present on the occasion.  NIFT, established in 1986 under the Ministry of Textiles,, is a statutory institute. Over the years, it has emerged as a leading institution for fashion education, bringing together traditional arts and crafts, academic knowledge, design innovation, technology, creative thinking and industry engagement.

. An 11-member technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in Nepal’s flood-affected areas today to facilitate the search and rescue of stranded individuals. The team, comprising doctors, paramedics and tunnel engineers, arrived in Kathmandu yesterday.Today, the team reached Trishuli in Nuwakot district to assist in efforts to rescue workers trapped in a tunnel belonging to a hydropower project. In a social media post, the Indian Embassy in Kathmandu said that a specialised technical team from India carried out on-site reconnaissance of hydropower tunnels in the area affected by the flash floods, which will help facilitate the early search and rescue of stranded individuals.After completing an aerial survey of the Chilime and Langtang areas, the Indian team began necessary rescue-related work around the tunnel area, according to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority. An 82-member joint security team comprising Nepal Army, Armed Police Force and Nepal Police personnel has been working since last night to clear debris and reach people believed to be trapped inside the tunnel.Nepali security forces have so far rescued 191 workers from tunnels at various hydropower projects in the country, according to the Nepal Army. However, reports of more people being trapped inside tunnels prompted Nepalese authorities to seek India’s assistance.The flash floods swept through the Bhotekoshi and Trishuli river corridors on Wednesday, killing hundreds of people and damaging roads, bridges, settlements and hydropower infrastructure.

. National Sports Day is being celebrated across the country today to commemorate the birth anniversary of one of India’s greatest sporting icons, Major Dhyan Chand. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today paid homage to the Indian Hockey Legend Major Dhyan Chand on the occasion of National Sports Day. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that Major Dhyan Chand’s brilliance in Indian hockey continues to inspire generations. Extending his greetings to all sports lovers, the Prime Minister said that their dedication, passion and determination make the nation proud.The day celebrates India’s rich sporting heritage and encourages people to make sports a regular part of their daily lives. National Sports Day 2026 is being observed as a three-day nationwide campaign under the pillars of Tribute, Play and Move. This year, National Sports Day is being celebrated under the call, Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein”. Various sporting activities are being organised across the country to mark the occasion.In Delhi, Union Ministers Dr Mansukh Mandaviya and Arjun Ram Meghwal participated in a cricket match under the campaign. Talking to the media, Dr Mandaviya called upon people to spend at least one hour on the playing field every week to remain fit and healthy. He said a fit youth and a healthy society are essential for building a prosperous nation. Mr Meghwal said he plays badminton every day. He said sports help people remain healthy and fit and also help in keeping stress away.The government has been making sustained investments in India’s sporting ecosystem, with the results increasingly visible on the global stage. India’s performances at major international sporting events reflect the country’s growing strength across Olympic, Paralympic and multi-sport disciplines.In the Union Budget 2026-27, over 4400 crore rupees were allocated to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, compared to just around 1200 crore rupees in 2013-14. India’s Olympic journey has witnessed a significant transformation in recent years. The country won two medals at Rio 2016, seven at Tokyo 2020 and six medals at Paris 2024. India’s performance at the Paralympic Games has also improved remarkably. The medal tally rose from four at Rio 2016 to 19 at Tokyo 2020.At Paris 2024, India recorded its best-ever Paralympic performance with 29 medals. India has also consistently improved its performance at the Asian Games. The country won 57 medals at the 2014 Asian Games and improved its tally to 69 in 2018 and scripted history by winning a record 107 medals in 2023. Initiatives such as Khelo India, the Target Olympic Podium Scheme, and Khelo India Rising Talent Identification are strengthening the sporting ecosystem and helping athletes prepare for competition at the highest level.

The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) has expanded the Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID)-based silver hallmarking ecosystem with 341 silver Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHCs) across 102 districts, and more than 25,000 silver jewellers are registered with BIS ahead of the festive season. The BIS informed that since the launch of the Silver HUID portal on 1 September last year, over 77 lakh silver jewellery pieces have already been hallmarked with HUID.The six-digit HUID under the Hallmarking System Assures Traceability of Silver Jewellery and Artefacts. The BIS advised consumers purchasing silver jewellery to look for the BIS hallmark and verify the HUID through the BIS CARE app. It also advised to purchase only hallmarked silver jewellery from BIS Registered Jewellers to be assured of its purity. Further, the BIS urged consumers to also obtain a proper invoice for the purchase of silver articles and retain it for future reference.
